															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.

																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).

																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

Uttar Pradesh UPESSC UP Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 Online Form for 12405 Post - Complete Details

UPESSC UP Primary Teacher PRT Recruitment 2026 Online Form Live Now! Advt 05/2026. 12405 Posts (Urban 11508 + Aided 897). Apply 16 September 2026 to 15 October 2026. Graduation + BTC/DElEd + UPTET/CTET. Age 21-40. Fee Rs.1000. Exam 03-04 December 2026. Level-6 Pay. Trending: UP Assistant Teacher form, UP PRT 12405 vacancy. (Updated 16 September 2026)

Important Dates

  • Name of Post: Uttar Pradesh UPESSC UP Primary Teacher Recruitment 2026 Online Form for 12405 Post Post Date: 16 September 2026  | 12:03 AM Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has Released Official Notificaton for Online Application form for the Post of Primary Teacher PRT (Advt.No. 05/2026) Recruitment 2026 for 12405 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to UPSESSC PRT Jobs. Online Application Start on September 16, 2026 & Last Date is October 15, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.   Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) UP Primary Teacher (PRT) Recruitment 2026 Advt No. : 05/2026 WWW.RESULTBHARAT.COM Application Fee Gen/ OBC/ EWS/ Other Candidates: Rs.1000/- SC/ ST Candidates: Rs.500 PH Candidates:  Rs.300/- Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode.  Important Date Online Apply Start On : 16 September 2026 Registration Last Date : 15 October 2026 Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 15 October 2026 Correction Date:  19 October 2026 Exam City Details : Notify Later Admit Card Released: Notify Later Exam Date : 03 & 04 December 2026 Answer Key Available: Notify Later Result Declared: Notify Later Age Limit as on 01-07-2026 Minimum Age:  21 Years Maximum Age: 40 Years For Age Relaxation Read the Official  Notification. Use Age Calculator:  Click Here Vacancy Details Total Vacancy : 12405 Post Post Name UR OBC EWS SC ST Total Post Eligibility Assistant Teacher in Urban Area Primary Schools 4746 3069 1116 2379 198 11508 Educational Degree: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University in India or its equivalent qualification recognized by the Government. Teacher Training Qualification: Must possess any of the following recognized teacher training qualifications: Basic Teacher Certificate (BTC) / Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.). 2-Year BTC (Urdu) or Special BTC. 2-Year Diploma in Special Education approved by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). 4-Year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.). 2-Year Diploma in Elementary Education in accordance with the NCTE Regulations, 2002. Teacher Eligibility Test: Must have passed the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for Primary Level (Classes 1 to 5) conducted by the State Government (UPTET) or Central Government (CTET). Assistant Teacher – Affiliated Primary (Non-Government Aided School) 378 164 07 348 00 897 Educational Degree: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University / Deemed University / Institution in India. 															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.

															UP Assistant Teacher 2026 Selection Process & Written Exam Pattern

															
																
																Selection Scheme:

																
																	
																	Selection for Assistant Teacher (Urban) and Assistant Teacher Attached Primary (Aided Non-Govt. School) posts will be based on a merit list prepared from a 360-Mark Written Examination.
																	
																
																
																
																Written Exam Highlights:

																
																	
																	Exam Mode / Question Type: Objective-Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each.
																	
																	
																	Total Questions: 120 Questions.
																	
																	
																	Total Marks: 360 Marks.
																	
																	
																	Exam Duration: 2 Hours (120 Minutes).
																	
																	
																	Marking Scheme: +3 Marks for each correct answer.
																	
																	
																	Negative Marking: 1 Mark deducted for every wrong or multiple-choice answer.
																	
																	
																	Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi).
																	
																	
																	OMR Marking: Candidates must darken the correct circle on the OMR sheet using a black ballpoint pen.
																	
																
																
																
																Tie-Breaking Rules (In Case of Equal Merit):

																
																	
																	First Preference: Higher Graduation Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Second Preference: Higher Teacher Training Qualification Percentage.
																	
																	
																	Third Preference: Older candidate in age.
																	
																
																
																
																Result Declaration:

																
																	
																	The written exam cut-off marks and individual candidate scores will be displayed on the official website after the completion of the recruitment process.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale: -Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 Pay Level 6, Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/-  
																Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Merit List.
